headline: Indexed k-mer search and parsing of large sequence and spectral datasets
label: Sequence Search And Indexing Tools
summary: Million-genome bacterial collections and gzipped sequencing files motivate indexed search and parsing that run on modest hardware.
synthesis: The dominant thread is indexed access to large sequence and spectral data that leaves source files intact. The k-mer matching methodology and Phylign-Fulgor pipeline target phylogenetically compressed bacterial collections, aiming at million-genome search on laptop hardware. The mim preprint adds a lightweight auxiliary index that enables fast, parallel, near-linear-scaling parsing of gzipped FASTQ without modifying or recompressing the originals. The published mass-spectrometry study addresses a different data type, proposing a simple SQL schema and comparing SQLite, DuckDB and Parquet on exploratory query speed and disk footprint. What is new is the explicit pairing of search, parsing and storage under an indexed design. The summaries report no cross-method benchmarks, and only the mass-spectrometry study is published, so shared claims remain provisional.
